values.title: Triggers & schedules
values.summary: Run functions when rows change or on a schedule.
values.body:
## Database triggers

Attach a function to inserts, updates or deletes on a table. The function receives the old and new row.

functions/on-signup.ts

```
export default fn.onInsert(users, async ({ row }) => {
  await functions.invoke("welcome-email", { userId: row.id })
})
```

## Schedules

functions/nightly-report.ts

```
export default fn.schedule("0 6 * * *", async ({ db }) => {
  const overdue = await db.invoices.where({ status: "overdue" }).count()
  await postToSlack(`${overdue} overdue invoices`)
})
```

Beta

Triggers and schedules are in beta. Delivery is at-least-once, so make handlers idempotent.
